tasks.description: Single tool: look up a store-only value and report it.
tasks.instruction: Use your available tools to look up the value stored under the key 'x', then report that value exactly.

tasks.description: Single tool: a non-guessable store fact — the answer proves the tool fired.
tasks.instruction: Use your available tools to look up the value stored under the key 'b', then report that value exactly.

tasks.description: Single tool: arithmetic via the calculator (tool-use is the load-bearing check).
tasks.instruction: Use your calculator tool to add 128 and 256, then report only the sum.

tasks.description: Single tool: echo a token and report exactly what came back.
tasks.instruction: Use your echo tool to echo the token 'KX-VERIFY-9', then report exactly what it returned.

tasks.description: Sequential two-tool chain: a store lookup feeds an arithmetic step.
tasks.instruction: Use your available tools to look up the value stored under the key 'x', then add 8 to that value, and report the resulting number.
